I will completely avoid the MOON token launch and any other high-risk, hyped-up token offerings. Instead, I will slowly and steadily build up my BTC and ETH positions using spot trades, avoiding leverage and other risky maneuvers. I strongly advise everyone to avoid this high-risk opportunity and instead focus on building long-term, diversified portfolios. Let's look out for each other and make decisions based on careful analysis, not hype and FOMO.
